parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Cloud Call Center instance for which to obtain phone numbers
parameters.help_zh: 待获取电话号码的呼叫中心实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the contact flow version
parameters.name: contact_flow_version_id

parameters.help_en:
The voice satisfaction survey content.

The key press information configured in Content must correspond to the prompt tones.
The key press information must correspond to the content in the mapping of url.pressKeyMapping
parameters.help_zh:
语音满意度内容。

Content中需要注意设置的按键信息与提示音要对应。
按键信息与url.pressKeyMapping中的mapping中的内容要对应
parameters.name: content

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the voice satisfaction survey. Default value: true
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启语音满意度，默认开启（true）
parameters.name: is_appraise
